controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:36:42.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:36:42.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
        AND event.outcome == "success"
| KEEP @timestamp, user.name, source.ip, message, event.outcome
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 10
